UNHALT AGENT RUNWAY CARD
USDC runway / your spend estimate

0–7 days / USDC runway scale

Sharing includes this public wallet and your estimates. A link rechecks current balances; a downloaded card keeps its observation date. USDC runway is an estimate, not provider credit or proof an agent is running. SOL fees, token rent and any USDC spent on gas are separate costs.

THE PROBLEM IS SIMPLE.

Smart agents.
Dumb ways to stop.

The wallet has money. The next job still fails. Gas, provider credit and runtime state are different constraints. UNHALT makes the boundary visible — and keeps receipts so an owned runtime can recover.
